title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Regarding the cost of the Copilot/Agent features (Manage consumption-based billing for agent capabilities)
summary: Copilot features in Business Central are included with the license at no extra cost, but new agent capabilities like Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent use consumption-based billing measured in Copilot Credits. Organizations can pay per credit consumed or purchase prepaid capacity through Microsoft Copilot Studio.
key_points: Copilot is included with the Business Central license at no extra cost, though fair-use policies or pricing may come later
Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent are billed by consumption in Copilot Credits; pay-as-you-go costs $0.01 per credit
A typical Sales Order Agent flow uses 14 credits, and the example of 100 requests per month comes to 1,650 credits (about $16.50)
Payables Agent uses 50 credits per invoice plus 5 per invoice line
Usage can be checked in the Power Platform admin center; Business Central licenses are not documented as including credits

quotes.text: Copilot in Business Central is included with your Business Central license at no extra cost.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that core Copilot functionality is free, helping organizations understand baseline costs

quotes.text: Selected agent capabilities in Business Central use consumption-based billing, charging per use.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that new agent features have variable costs based on actual usage, not fixed licensing
